images.title: 2367 grouped into landmarks
images.purpose: Shows 2367 written as MMCCCLXVII, with each group of symbols bracketed by the landmark value it adds.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. The number 2367 at the top, the Roman numeral large in the middle, and six small brackets under its symbol groups.
images.exact_structure: Top centre: 2367 in dark text. Middle: the Roman numeral MMCCCLXVII in large amber (#E69F00) letters with even spacing. Under it, exactly 6 teal (#0072B2) brackets, left to right: under MM labelled 2000, under CCC labelled 300, under L labelled 50, under X labelled 10, under V labelled 5, under II labelled 2. One thin grey (#6B7280) arrow points down from 2367 to the numeral. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Take as many of the largest landmark as fit, then the next: 2367 is MMCCCLXVII.

image_decisions.why: The brackets show how each part of the numeral comes from a landmark, largest first.
